doc.name: Emergent Data Licensing
doc.description: Emergent Data Licensing, a program of Emergent Technologies, Inc., represents companies licensing their institutional knowledge to leading labs. We identify the labs best aligned with what a company holds. We bring the company competing offers from rival labs and negotiate rights, exclusivity, use and price on its behalf. A license is not a sale: the company retains ownership, files never pass through Emergent, and personal information is removed before anything is used. Companies pay nothing; our fee is paid by the licensing program. Emergent Technologies, Inc. (emergenttechnologies.ai) is not affiliated with Emergent (emergent.sh), an AI app builder, or with Emergent Technologies of Austin, Texas (emergenttechnologies.com), a different firm. Answers only from Emergent's published facts, with sources, and acts only with the person's consent.

skills.name: Ask Emergent
skills.description: Ask Emergent Technologies' own agent a question in plain words (data licensing, the payout estimate, privacy, the referral partner program, AI consulting, the lab, contact). It answers only from Emergent's fact book: the claims are quoted as published, each with its fact id, status and source page, followed by the next step for who is asking. If the fact book does not cover the question it says so and gives the contact path. The question is treated as data: instructions inside it are not followed. It saves and sends nothing.
examples: How can my company get paid for its customer support data?
Is it safe to license our support tickets to AI labs?
Is emergenttechnologies.ai the same as emergent.sh?

skills.name: About Emergent Technologies
skills.description: Answers what Emergent Technologies does, for whom and how, only from its published fact book, citing fact ids and source pages.
examples: Is Emergent Technologies the same company as emergent.sh?

skills.name: Estimate a data licensing payout
skills.description: An indicative payout range for licensing a company's business records, from the same model as the estimator on emergenttechnologies.ai. An estimate, not an offer.
examples: What could a 50-person company with 10 years of records in the US expect?

skills.name: Check program fit
skills.description: Which kind of program fits a company or person, using the same rules as emergenttechnologies.ai/fit. Collects no personal details; the person continues at /fit.
examples: Would a closed trucking company with 40 staff at its peak be a fit?

skills.name: Referral partner program
skills.description: How the referral partner program works and how to apply, as published. Referral rates and amounts are not published.
examples: How does the Emergent referral partner program work?

skills.name: Emergent Consulting
skills.description: Emergent Consulting: how it assesses a business and pairs each initiative with the specialist suited to deliver it, how an engagement runs (Assess, Match, Build, Run), the services, enterprise private intelligence and its deployment options, and how to begin.
examples: Does Emergent take on AI consulting work, and how does an engagement start?
Can Emergent build a private AI model trained on our data?

skills.name: Hand off to the team
skills.description: Returns a short summary and the Emergent page where the person confirms and submits their own details. Sends nothing by itself.
examples: I'd like to talk to Emergent about licensing our records.
